notes.title: Full Release
notes.notes:
Hello,

Today, Minds of Nations, has successfully completed it's Early Access phase. We have entered Early Access on February 20, 2020 and today, 3 years later we exit that phase.

I would like to thank everyone who has helped us develop the game. Every bug report and feedback helped improve the game. THANK YOU. Everyone who has downloaded the game on steam during Early Access will keep it.

Based off of your reviews and feedback we switched the game from online-only to a focus on single-player and added multiple features.

In this time we have added numerous updates including: single-player, resources & industry, economy & trade, vassalage, win conditions, souls, influence, centralization,  unforseen consequences effect pack, chat, rankings, stories, maps, music, help videos, thousands of bugs fixed and numerous other small updates.

So what's next ? 

[EDIT 19/02/2024] Currently, I'm hoping to translate the game into multiple languages. Unfortunately, the game failed financially. For the time being any other updates are stopped except critical bug fixes.

If you are new, welcome to the game, I hope you will enjoy it and let me know if you have any issues. We have a community discord, an in-game forum and the steam forum where I regularly check for reports.

Thank you.

notes.title: New MMO Sim System, Single-Player Bug Fixes, Blitz, Full Release
notes.notes:
Hello,

FULL RELEASE

The game will be fully released in the coming days.

Everyone that got the game on steam during early access will keep the steam game.

SINGLE-PLAYER BUGS

- Quality of life improvements with 4k displays at 100% scaling.
- Forum links when not logged in.
- UI display unpleasantness on treaty pages.
- New Stories broke some bonus expiration. It is now fixed.
- You were unable to select capitals on the omnemia magna by estris map.
- A few ideological effects were not working properly.
- Texts and other minor fixes.

NEW SYSTEM FOR MMO - AUTOMATIC NEW SIMS

New MMO sims will start every 3 days and end after 2 weeks [2,000 years]. When the year is 0 to 300, we usually retain more players. Thus we should maximize this period. First day will always last for 24 hours, after which you can join and start playing instantly within a 3 day window. After those 3 days, games that are not completely filled with humans will be filled with EASY Level A.I. nations.
 
I think it might be more competitive to have shorter MMO sims. We can extend this period of play after some feedback.

Some continents will have victory conditions, others will not.

The system now automatically starts new continents, pauses the game, unpauses the game, decides winners [when there are win conditions], ends existing games, moves results to your rankings page, fills continent with A.I.'s freeing me to focus on developing the game .

MMO BLITZ

Blitz MMO is a faster sim for online games. It will last for 4 hours at a speed of 8 years per minute. For reference: On the single-player version you can customize speeds from 1 year / 30 seconds to 10 years / 30 seconds. While the current MMO slow version is 1 year every 10 minutes.

The BLITZ system is also done pending implementation on the live system. I'm currently considering to hold BLITZ games only on weekends due to the size of our current player-base.

I'd like to test it a few more times before releasing it into the wild.

Thanks

notes.title: 1.2.81 - Some changes to the previous update based on community feedback
notes.notes:
1. After a conquest the influence cost per 20 gold is 0.1. Which increases every 50 years by 5 gold after year 432 [when the peaceful context expires].

2. After a conquest the influence cost per 20,000 food is 0.1. This also updates every 50 years by 5,000 food after year 432 [when the peaceful context expires].

3. They are also upgradable effects:

"Gold for 0.1 influence when suing for peace"
"Food for 0.1 influence when suing for peace".

4. The person that offers food/gold has to pay the influence cost. This is done in this manner because @Not a new name 2 found an exploit. You could offer a lot of food and drain the other nation of influence. 

5. Peace offer summary has been fixed. It had a few bugs.

notes.title: Idea cost. Influence cost. Trade limits on prestige products. Bug fixes.
notes.notes:
Adjustments to metas, small tweaks and other bug fixes:

1. Conquering an unconnected capital now costs 20 Influence with 5 Centralization.

The old strategy of conquering far away inactive as soon as the peaceful context ended was back.

2. Conquering a connected capital now costs 10 Influence with 3 Centralization.

3. Idea costs have been increased. Quite significantly for the late stages of a sim. We should not reach thousands of ideas added again.

4. You cannot sell someone else's prestige products.

A number of users would move around a single prestige product. Middlemen would earn as much as the creator. This had to stop.

5. Clearing prestige products now requires only 1,000.

6. Clearing a prestige product now yields 1 influence.

7. Famous Products ranking is now based on most nations that have cleared your at least 1 of your prestige products.

8. Prestige products can now be cleared 10 times each.

9. Design fixes on iOS.

10. Design Fixes on Steam.

11. Missing nation flag during peace offers.

12. It now costs 1 influence for every 200 gold you extract during peace negotiations.

13. It now costs 1 influence for every 200,000 food you extract during peace negotiations.

Farming gold thru conquest was a 0-cost strategy. 

14. Rankings aesthetic improved and bug fixed.

15. Protectorate used to cost too much in gold.

16. When sending a peace offer you'll get lots more information on why it was not auto-accepted.

17. You were unable to send an insult treaty sometimes.

18. Effects would not expire if they were predefined [ unforeseen consequences ].

19. Conquering a province would not always increase prestige product yield.

20. Destroyed nations would not close ongoing trades.

21. Total agricultural land was not updating after conquests.

22. Province fertility would drop into the negative if environmental degradation was left unchecked.

23. Hours until the next technological level is reached has been removed from the map UI.

notes.title: AFK DEFENSE, ARABLE LAND, TRANSLATIONS & MORE BUGFIXES
notes.notes:
MAY1-15: AFK DEFENSE, TRANSLATIONS & MANY BUGFIXES

*UPDATES*:
- "AFK DEFENSE":
	 An army will automatically spawn if you are attacked while AFK.
	 You can disable this option. 
	 You can modify the settings of this army or disable it by clicking in Governance Ideas / Military / AFK Standing Army / Customize.
          It costs 35% of your gold production each year [we may decrease this next sim].
	  It is enabled by default.

	 The AFK system will go into effect tomorrow at 22:00 CST. You can disable it before then. By disabling you could avoid an unmanaged loss of life. It can be enabled or disabled at will. It is not opt-in/opt-out. 



- "TRANSLATIONS":
	We have begun the translation process: https://www.localizor.com/game/39/translations
	We are looking for native speakers that can help us. All languages are welcome.
	
	Guidelines and CyberPoints-reward information are found there.
	We may adjust those if necessary.

	Also, we will limit the number of night attacks that can be used per war as of next sim. 
	This is necessary due to the influx of CyberPoints the translation process will bring.	

	The first round of rewards will come in about 2 weeks. After that, it should become a little faster as I improve my localizor crawling system.

- "Forgotten password" now works.

- You cannot send expedition food supplies back to the populace. This could have been used to avoid the arable land cap.

- We made a significant performance update with the completion of unit orders. The lag should decrease.

- Sieging multiple provinces in quick succession would not work. It now works. Press "shift" then the provinces you wish to siege. The order queue will say "then" instead of the specific year of the order.
  That means that after each siege the order time will change accordingly.
- Shamans were only available during year 0-288. Now they are available for the first 288 years of any nation.

[MAY 1ST UPDATE]
- In the previous sims, you'd have some nations reach a trillion in population. This is obviously ridiculous. Thus: food produced has now been capped.
- You can only produce as much food as your people can work the nation's arable land. About 60% of your arable land is produced. This will be adjusted next sim based on relief. Slightly higher for coastal, river regions, and lower for mountainous regions.
- In the coming weeks and months, we will add new civilian units that gather food. Fishing fleets and hunting parties.
- To send units off nation, you will now have to spend “expedition food supplies”.
- 25% of your food produced is saved for future expeditions.
[------------------]


*BUGFIXES*:

- Sometimes you were able to leave a province and the siege would go on. This is now fixed.
- There was an exploit for building wonders quickly. It is fixed.
- The technology page would not show incarnations correctly.
- Leaderboards would not update correctly after the year 1000 or so.
- Becoming a vassal would drag the liege into war but not the liege's vassals.
- Wandering scholars would give +17 peaceful contexts instead of 1.
- After occupying an entire nation and suing for peace, the offer would not be auto accepted if you requested the entire food & gold balance.
- Expired occupations would send buggy notifications. {name} instead of the province name.
- Atheism effect had a research malus instead of a bonus.
- Horsemanship for teens had a malus instead of a bonus.
- Raising cavalry would not deduct support staff, but would give the support back when disbanding.
- You could send blank messages in the continent chat.
- If you had a truce you would still start battles would that person if two units where in the same province.
- There were several continents that had malformed island data. You were unable to invade the provinces.
- We made some UI fixes. The [x] button in several provinces now scrolls with you.
- The [x] button was below certain UI elements in a few pages.
- More UI fixes: font color and border colors not being saved correctly on several panels.
- Refreshing on the web version would mess up the map and pages.
- Occupied provinces UI color is now stronger.
- Ally with a peaceful context was able to relieve occupations.
- UI performance update.
- Spam click prevention for ideas.
- A bug where the population would not always be updated at the end of the year.
- Another performance update to the cron system.
- We made a performance update when sending unit orders.
- Fixed a problem with heraldry sometimes having a blue rectangle around it when selected.
- Fixed a bug with the translation page hiding units after being visited.

There are a few bugs that are still active
Custom options are not working correctly, unit propaganda, inability to claim independence, and a few other small issues.

*In the coming days I will focus on adding several maps for sim #4*, work on the aforementioned bugs and then redo the claim-integration system.

More significant updates on the todo list:
- Idea pricing change.
- We will also experiment with a random package 2 positive 1 negative set for ideas. I've been promising this for several weeks now.

- Jobs, trade, and new resources.
- Blitz version.

The web version is now updated. Steam app is updated.
Android and iOS should become available in the next 48 hours.

Thank you.

notes.title: SIMULATION #2 + ASTRAL PROBE UPDATE
notes.notes:
NEW SIMULATION [#2] - STATE OF THE GAME ADDRESS [& UPDATES]

Hello,

Yesterday we've concluded the first simulation. We've had quite a few bugs. We were able to fix quite a few still [list at the bottom of the post]:



Today, at 22:00 GMT, we will start the second simulation [ *but you can create your nation now and get acquainted with the new updates* - the sim is not changing years until 22:00 GMT - but everything else works ].
Four major updates are already here and several are being worked on:

1) Astral Probing - a new unit that is used to bring souls to your nation.
In the previous simulation souls were tied to provinces and regions. This led to a nations building wide [attacking and expanding becoming way too powerful and leading every single ranking].
In this new simulation, you have to create a special unit that "gathers"/"brings" souls to your nation-school.
This should separate the game into two rankings at the end of the sim:
- The white ranking: sophistication and freed souls.
- The black ranking: battles, country size, etc.

This unit is of three typs: Lucid Dreamers, Shammans and Wandering Recluses. Each has can find different things in the astral dimension.
The later two can also find gameplay peaceful contexts.

This update is a 2nd update after the "Tools for the Peaceful" update that addresses issues for the lovers of peace out there.

2) Maximum units mechanic has changed.
You can now create 3 civillian units [ explorers, colonists and astral probers ] and 3 military units.
1 civillian unit is added every 500 years.
While military units can be added using ideology [the previous options were changed to this].

3) Idea cost.
3a) Categories no longer cost a single idea.
3b) Answer cost goes up based on game year - not country size.

UPCOMING UPDATES

I wanted to add several other updates, but I was unable to finish them in time.
They will be added *during* this second simulation [if I finish them in time]:

- Continent chat.
- A separation and randomisation between ideas & effects. [ https://steamcommunity.com/app/1117160/discussions/0/1753527487239031253/ ]
- Hidden colonisation effects being random.
- Small maps for mobile.
- Cassus bellis as percentage after 30 provinces. The late game is boring for people looking to conquer.
- Rankings page for previous simulation.
- Food production limited by province area and fishing units.
- Phone push notifications.
- Login bonuses.

Once those are done we will continue with:

- BLITZ version [2-3 hour games].
- Better graphics for buildings and provinces.
- Many more maps.
- Many more stories.
- Translating the gam into YOUR mother tongue [and mine].

Of course, bugs will be the priority.

We were able to fix quite a few in this first simulation, This last week, I wanted to focus on the aformentioned updates tho and we didn't fix as many as in the previous weeks.

Thank you !

This means that a 1,000,000 strong army will have regiments of 10,000.
An army of 50,000,000 will have slots of 500,000.
This should make battles finish much quicker.
Under the old system [fixed regiments of 1,000] there were several battles [of over 50,000,000 men] that took days to finish.

https://steamcommunity.com/app/1117160/discussions/0/1753527487239746703/
- Laying a siege would not work if you were insulted and had another ongoing war.
- Province integration panel was shown to non-occupying nations.
- If someone landed a colonist on your province and clicked “COLONIZE THIS PROVINCE” he would have been able to colonize your province… [FIXED]
- Bonuses for Who Leads options would stack up. Thus when removing it would remove previously stacked bonuses, causing huge maluses.
- Demanding a province connected to your capital [new update] would not work in some edge cases.

FEB26:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1117160/discussions/0/1753527487235216439/
"TOOLS FOR THE PEACEFUL" UPDATE AND BUGFIXES, ONE LAST PEACE EXTENTION
The "Tools for the Peaceful" Update is being installed right now.

It is going to take several hours for it to update to all servers.

We have to extend the peaceful context for 24 more hours while everyone gets aquainted with the update.

We've added several tools for nation-states that wish to play peacefuly.

1. GAMEPLAY PEACEFUL CONTEXT

Completing the first level of the following idea trees will give you a 24 hour peaceful context:
- Education
- Foreign Policy
- Transparency

- Death
- Family
- Childcare

- Austeritis
- Reflections
- Insight meditation
- Other meditation techniques

It is called "gameplay peaceful context".

Declaring a war, will actually deduct 1"gameplay peaceful context" from your balance.

This avoids the strategy of declaring war, conquering provinces, then appying your own peaceful context.

BUGS:
